expo._comment_newArch: SDK 54 dan boshlab yangi arxitektura (Fabric/bridgeless) MAJBURIY: react-native-reanimated 4 va boshqa SDK 54 native kutubxonalari eski arxitekturada umuman qurilmaydi (`assertNewArchitectureEnabledTask` ishdan bo'shaydi). Ilgari expo-gl eski arxitekturani talab qilardi, lekin u 2026-10-31 da butunlay olib tashlandi (PhotoSwipe RN View'ga ko'chirildi).

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: LookSave uses the camera to take a photo of your face and body so it can build your try-on avatar. The photo is stored on our servers and sent to an external AI service to generate the avatar. You can delete it in the app at any time.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: LookSave accesses your photo library only when you choose a photo — for example, your own photo for the try-on avatar, a profile picture, or, if you are a seller, your store logo and product photos. The selected photo is stored on our servers and used only for that purpose. You can delete it at any time.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: LookSave uses your location to show nearby clothing stores and their products on the map.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: LookSave does not record audio. The camera is used only to take photos for your try-on avatar.
